kim_2022_md_cephalotocin.provider: Marine Drugs 20(5):328 (MDPI), full text in PMC9144402
kim_2022_md_cephalotocin.terms: Full text read (Europe PMC XML): synthetic cephalotocin CYFRNCPIG-NH2 with a disulfide bond, purity >98% (HPLC, MALDI-TOF; AnyGen, Gwangju); Eurofins Cerep human receptor assays in triplicate, 4-parameter logistic fit; EC50 10.02 nM at V1bR (RBL cells, intracellular Ca2+) and 12.09 nM at V2R (CHO cells, cAMP HTRF) in section 2.2; OXTR and V1aR not activated up to 50 uM. The paper names the species Octopus vulgaris without a sampling region.
kim_2022_md_cephalotocin.title: An Octopus-Derived Peptide with Antidiuretic Activity in Rats (Kim Y-J et al. 2022)

li_2020_mer_osinensis_genome.terms: The genome paper of the assembly that carries NW_021826408.1: a female East Asian common octopus (Octopus sinensis). Abstract read; the sample locality is read from BioSample SAMN11633729.
li_2020_mer_osinensis_genome.title: Chromosome-level genome assembly of the East Asian common octopus (Octopus sinensis) using PacBio sequencing and Hi-C technology (Li F et al. 2020)

ncbi_osinensis_genome_nw021826408.provider: NCBI RefSeq / INSDC (genome by Yellow Sea Fisheries Research Institute, Chinese Academy of Fishery Sciences)
ncbi_osinensis_genome_nw021826408.terms: Nucleotides 8387-8542 (plus strand) translate to MSQNCFAIVQLLFVLFTVCSLFIATTDGCYFRNCPIGGKRATPMSEQGSNQK: the cephalotocin nonapeptide (aa 29-37) followed by the Gly amidation donor and the KR cleavage site. The 156 nt are identical to codons 1-52 of the Japanese Octopus vulgaris cephalotocin gene AB108430.1 (Kanda et al. 2003). BioSample SAMN11633729: Octopus sinensis, 'China: littoral waters of Zhoushan, Zhejiang province', collected 2018-01, isolate Ov201803, liver. The NCBI protein annotation of this locus (LOC115227447) is withdrawn; the evidence is the nucleotide record.
